levels.label: Template
levels.description: Structure only; no reusable business behavior.

levels.label: Standard
levels.description: Rules/checklists used to generate project-specific documentation.

levels.label: Pattern Pack
levels.description: Reusable skeleton/relationship pattern; project still fills substantive details.

levels.label: Capability Pack
levels.description: Versioned reusable capability with canonical docs, variants, provenance and upgrade lifecycle.

rules: Never create a capability pack only because a feature could theoretically be reused.
Use standards for project-specific or unstable business features.
Promote to pattern pack after repeatable structure is observed.
Promote to capability pack only when behavior and documentation are substantially stable across projects.
After import, project-local documentation is canonical; pack metadata stays in .project-docs.
